title: Sunshine Law request: Flock Safety contracts and Wing LPR records - MOCIC

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Missouri Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Every contract, master services agreement, terms and conditions, order form, quote, amendment, renewal, statement of work and addendum between MOCIC and Flock Safety, including any covering Falcon, Wing, Wing LPR, Wing Livestream, Wing Replay, Wing Gateway, Wing Suite, or any other Flock product or service.
2. All invoices, purchase orders and payment records under those agreements.
3. Any agreement, memorandum of understanding or sharing authorization governing MOCIC's use of, or sharing of data through, the Flock network named "MOCIC - Wing LPR" or any other Flock network, including any record stating which agencies, cameras or camera owners are connected to it.
4. Any agreement with a third party (camera owners, integrators or vendors) to connect third-party cameras to the Flock platform.
5. Procurement and approval records for the above, including quotes, sole-source justifications, board or committee minutes and resolutions, and records identifying the funding source.

MOCIC is a quasi-public governmental body under section 610.010(4)(f) RSMo: a nonprofit whose primary activities are carried out under agreements with public governmental bodies. If MOCIC disputes that, state the basis in writing within three business days and identify its custodian of records.

Respond within three business days as section 610.023 requires. If any record is not immediately available, state the reason and the earliest date it will be available. If you deny any part of this request, provide a written statement citing the specific provision of law relied on, and release every portion that is not covered.

Provide an estimate before incurring any fees. I request a waiver or reduction under section 610.026: this request serves the public interest and is not primarily commercial. Send records electronically; no paper copies.

Preserve all responsive records while this request is pending.

J

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar
